minor.name: Singed
minor.card: disadvantage on its next attack roll

offensive.name: Fierce
offensive.description: Your fire burns hotter with every drop of fury.

tiers.text: The damage is turned into fire damage and the total damage output increases by 2 additional dice. The fire does not go out at once — a creature that fails, or is hit, takes Twice your Verum Modifier in fire damage at the start of its next turn.
tiers.card: +2 dice · damage becomes Fire · 2×VM fire at the start of their next turn

tiers.text: The fire damage increases by 4 additional dice, and the burn that lingers becomes Three Times your Verum Modifier at the start of the creature's next turn.
tiers.card: +4 dice · the lingering burn becomes 3×VM

tiers.text: Fire damage increases by 6 additional dice. Creatures that fail the save or are hit directly take fire damage equal to Five Times your Verum Modifier at the start of their next turn.
tiers.card: +6 dice · the lingering burn becomes 5×VM

tiers.text: Fire damage increases by 8 additional dice. Creatures that fail or are hit directly are Ablaze — taking Five Times your Verum Modifier at the start of each of their turns for 1 minute, unless extinguished by cognitive means that counter this effect.
tiers.card: +8 dice · the burn no longer stops — Ablaze, 5×VM at the start of each of their turns for 1 min

offensive.name: Wildfire
offensive.description: Fire does not stop when it has done what you asked of it.

tiers.text: A creature that fails is set Ablaze, taking Twice your Verum Modifier in fire damage at the start of each of its turns until it or someone beside it spends an action to smother the flames.
tiers.card: Ablaze — 2×VM fire each turn until someone spends an action putting them out

tiers.text: It spreads. A creature that is Ablaze and ends its turn within 5 feet of another creature sets that creature Ablaze as well, and anything Ablaze sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and cannot hide.
tiers.card: Spreads to anyone within 5 ft at the end of a burning creature's turn · nothing Ablaze can hide

tiers.text: The burn becomes Five Times your Verum Modifier, the spread reaches 10 feet, and smothering it now takes both an action and a successful Dexterity check against your Verum DC.
tiers.card: 5×VM fire each turn · spreads 10 ft · smothering needs an action AND a Dex check {DC}

conditions.name: Ablaze
conditions.escape: an action and a Dexterity check vs Verum DC

tiers.text: The fire no longer needs a body to travel by. At the start of each of your turns it spreads to every creature and flammable thing within 15 feet of anything already burning, and it does not go out while there is still something within reach that will take it.
tiers.card: Spreads 15 ft from everything burning, every turn · it does not go out while anything nearby can still catch

supportive.name: Life-Bringer
supportive.description: Fire is not only death. It is the light that holds back the dark.

tiers.text: When this effect damages a creature, you or one ally within 30 feet may regain 1d4 hit points.
tiers.card: You or an ally within 30 ft regains 1d4

tiers.text: You may split the healing between two allies for a combined total of 2d6 hit points.
tiers.card: 2d6 split between two allies

tiers.text: If a creature died within the last round and was within range of the effect, you may restore them to 1 HP in a burst of reviving flame.
tiers.card: Revive a creature that died this round at 1 HP

tiers.text: Choose up to 5 allies touched by the flame. Each regains 6d10 hit points, removes one condition (except Petrified or Unconscious), and is wreathed in fire for 1 minute, dealing 1d8 fire damage on melee hits.
tiers.card: 5 allies: 6d10 each · each drops a condition · wreathed in fire 1 min, 1d8 on their melee hits

supportive.name: Unrelenting Heat
supportive.description: Your flame cannot be denied by resistance or resilience.

tiers.text: This effect's fire damage ignores resistance.
tiers.card: Fire damage ignores resistance

tiers.text: The fire bypasses immunity: against it, immunity counts only as resistance.
tiers.card: Immunity counts only as resistance against it

tiers.text: Fire damage dealt to flammable objects or creatures vulnerable to fire is always treated as maximum.
tiers.card: Max damage vs flammable or fire-vulnerable

tiers.text: The fire bypasses all resistance and immunity, prevents invisibility or hiding via a persistent heat signature, and dissolves magical barriers of 5th level or lower on contact.
tiers.card: Ignores all resistance and immunity · no hiding · dissolves barriers ≤5th

supportive.name: Infernal Passion
supportive.description: You do not merely draw fire — you become it.

tiers.text: Gain advantage on your next Charisma check or saving throw before the end of your next turn.
tiers.card: Advantage on your next Cha check or save

tiers.text: For 1 minute, you and allies within 30 feet gain +2 to attack rolls while the fire persists.
tiers.card: 1 min: you and allies within 30 ft get +2 to attack

tiers.text: You and every ally within 30 feet cannot be Frightened while the fire holds, and each of you adds your Verum Modifier to the first damage roll you make on your turn.
tiers.card: You and allies within 30 ft: can't be Frightened · +{VM} to your first damage roll each turn

buff.damage: +VM to the first damage roll each turn

tiers.text: You are the fire now. You and your allies within 30 feet are immune to being Frightened or Charmed and add your Verum Modifier to every damage roll, and the first time each round one of you would drop to 0 hit points, that creature instead drops to 1 and is wreathed in flame until the end of its next turn.
tiers.card: Immune to Frightened and Charmed · +{VM} to every damage roll · once a round, one of you drops to 1 instead of 0

control.name: Wildflame Wake
control.description: Fire leaves behind more than ashes — it reshapes the ground itself.

tiers.text: Terrain scorched by the effect becomes difficult terrain for enemies until the end of your next turn.
tiers.card: Scorched ground = difficult terrain for enemies

tiers.text: The area becomes blazing terrain — any creature starting its turn there takes 2d6 fire damage.
tiers.card: Blazing terrain — 2d6 fire on starting a turn there

tiers.text: Creatures entering or starting their turn in scorched terrain must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be Ignited.
tiers.card: Enter or start turn there: Dex save or Ignited

tiers.text: The terrain erupts into a Living Flame Storm for 1 minute. Hostile creatures treat it as impassable solid terrain unless immune to fire. Any creature that enters or starts its turn there takes 5d10 fire damage.
tiers.card: Living Flame Storm 1 min — impassable, 5d10 fire to enter or start there

tiers.text: Your creations are of living flame. They shed bright light in a 20-foot radius, and a creature that touches or strikes a Structure, or is hit by a Construct or an Object you made, takes 1d6 fire damage.
tiers.card: Creations are living flame · 20-ft light · 1d6 fire to touch or be hit

tiers.text: That fire damage becomes 2d6. Your creations are immune to fire and cannot be extinguished by nonmagical means.
tiers.card: That damage becomes 2d6 · creations immune to fire

tiers.text: A creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of one of your Structures takes 2d6 fire damage. A Construct's attacks Ignite on a hit.
tiers.card: 2d6 fire to end turn within 5 ft of a Structure · Constructs Ignite on hit

tiers.text: Your creations are eternal flame — unaffected by cold or water effects of 5th level or lower. When a Structure or Construct is destroyed, it erupts for 6d10 fire damage in a 20-foot radius (Dexterity save for half).
tiers.card: Eternal flame · destroyed creation erupts 6d10 fire in 20 ft (Dex half)

utility.name: Hearthlight
utility.description: Fire was the first gift, and it was never only for burning.

tiers.text: Kindle bright light in a 30-foot radius, keep a group warm through any cold, light mundane fires at a distance, and sense sources of heat within 60 feet.
tiers.card: 30-ft light · group stays warm · light fires at range · sense heat 60 ft

tiers.text: See clearly through smoke and heat haze; heat a nonmagical object until it glows; purify food and water by flame; and ride your own flame — once on each of your turns a burst of fire carries you up to 30 feet in any direction, including straight up.
tiers.card: See through smoke and haze · heat an object · purify food and water · ride your own flame 30 ft in any direction, once a turn

tiers.text: Step into one fire and out of another you can see within 300 feet. Burn or melt through a 5-foot cube of nonmagical material each turn.
tiers.card: Step fire-to-fire within 300 ft · burn through a 5-ft cube per turn

tiers.text: The pyre of renewal: burn away one curse or magical effect of 6th level or lower from a willing creature, or reforge a broken nonmagical object whole.
tiers.card: Burn away a curse or effect ≤6th, or reforge a broken object whole

complementEffects.name: Ember's Bite
complementEffects.description: The primary effect carries a burning edge.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw, the target takes bonus fire damage equal to one damage die of the primary effect's type (min 1d6). On a failed Dexterity save vs your Verum DC, they are also Ignited — taking 1d6 fire damage at the start of their next turn.
effect.card: +1 die fire · Dex save or Ignited (1d6 at start of next turn)

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Bonus damage increases to two dice.
Level 11+: Bonus damage increases to three dice, and the Ignited condition lasts 1 minute instead of one turn.

complementEffects.name: Hearthglow
complementEffects.description: A flicker of warmth accompanies the spell.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, one creature within 30 feet regains HP equal to your spellcasting modifier. If the primary effect heals, this is added on top.
effect.card: One creature within 30 ft regains VM HP

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Choose up to two creatures to receive this healing.
Level 11+: Each healed creature also gains temporary HP equal to your spellcasting modifier until the start of your next turn.
upgrades.card: Each also gains VM temp HP

complementEffects.name: Cinder March
complementEffects.description: Wherever the spell lands, fire claims the ground.

effect.text: The point of impact becomes scorched terrain in a 10-foot radius until the end of your next turn. Creatures must succeed on a Dexterity save vs your Verum DC or be pushed 5 feet away from the center.
effect.card: Scorched terrain 10 ft · Dex save or pushed 5 ft

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Scorched terrain persists 1 minute. Creatures entering take 1d6 fire damage per 5 feet traveled through it.
upgrades.card: Terrain lasts 1 min · 1d6 fire per 5 ft moved through

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Creatures that fail cannot willingly move toward the center for 1 round.
upgrades.card: Those who fail can't move toward the centre for 1 round

complementEffects.name: Smoldering Haze
complementEffects.description: The heat rattles the mind as much as the body.

effect.text: Creatures hit by or failing their save must succeed on a Dexterity save vs your Verum DC or suffer disadvantage on their next attack roll.
effect.card: Dex save or disadvantage on their next attack

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Penalty extends to all attack rolls until the end of their next turn.
upgrades.card: Disadvantage on all attacks until end of their next turn

penalty.disadvantage: all attack rolls until the end of their next turn

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Creatures that fail also have their movement speed reduced by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.
upgrades.card: Also −10 ft speed until end of their next turn
